title: Intersect Capital LLC Acquires 4,488 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by John. R. Edwardson on Jul 11th, 2018 // No Comments
Intersect Capital LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.6% during the 1st quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 46,807 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 4,488 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises about 4.2% of Intersect Capital LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 3rd biggest position. Intersect Capital LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $7,853,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of the company. Capital Insight Partners LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 4.9% during the fourth quarter. Capital Insight Partners LLC now owns 6,292 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,065,000 after purchasing an additional 293 shares during the last quarter. Chemical Bank raised its position in shares of Apple by 0.3% in the 4th quarter. Chemical Bank now owns 92,548 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $15,662,000 after buying an additional 299 shares during the period. FTB Advisors Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 0.3% in the 1st quarter. FTB Advisors Inc. now owns 88,110 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $14,949,000 after buying an additional 302 shares during the period. Schaper Benz & Wise Investment Counsel Inc. WI raised its position in shares of Apple by 0.4% in the 4th quarter. Schaper Benz & Wise Investment Counsel Inc. WI now owns 76,786 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,994,000 after buying an additional 303 shares during the period. Finally, Perennial Advisors LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 1.0% in the 4th quarter. Perennial Advisors LLC now owns 31,554 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,340,000 after buying an additional 303 shares during the period. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 58.07% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Several research analysts recently weighed in on the company. UBS Group set a $210.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Thursday, June 7th. Goldman Sachs Group reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $164.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, June 5th. Argus increased their target price on Apple from $210.00 to $225.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. Royal Bank of Canada increased their target price on Apple from $203.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock an “outperform” rating in a research report on Tuesday, June 5th. Finally, BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Friday, June 8th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-one have given a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $207.76. In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,261,203.50. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,976 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, May 23rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $187.74, for a total value of $2,811,594.24. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 73,302 shares in the company, valued at $13,761,717.48. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last ninety days, insiders have sold 192,208 shares of company stock worth $35,104,302. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Shares of Apple opened at $190.35 on Wednesday, according to MarketBeat Ratings . Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $144.38 and a 1 year high of $194.20. The stock has a market cap of $967.01 billion, a PE ratio of 18.40, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.57 and a beta of 1.24. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a quick ratio of 1.37 and a current ratio of 1.46.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The business had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company earned $2.10 earnings per share. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. equities research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current year.
Apple declared that its board has approved a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to repurchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock repurchase programs are typically a sign that the company’s board believes its shares are undervalued.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
